headline: MIA @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.80 at PHI 4.33, with a projected total of 8.14. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +0.76 runs while PHI moved +0.35, changing the projected margin by +0.41 runs. The projected total climbed +1.11, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Bryson Stott, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Owen Caissie, Derek Hill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
